notes: the second isnad (وحدثنا علي بن عبد الله) carries the same story of the milk kinship, so it is a route of this saying
«قال سمعت ابن أبي مليكة» is rule 5: Ibn Abi Mulayka is a link
«أو سمعته منه» is the transmitter's own doubt, kept in the text, not a route
the black woman and the Prophet inside the story are not links
